paper_title: Hardness of the Binary Covering Radius Problem in Large 𝓁_p Norms
classifications: Theory of computation → Problems, reductions and completeness
source_locator: Explicit open question on PDF page 7
statement: We again emphasize the central open question that we consider in this work: For which values of γ = γ(p) is γ-GapCRP in the ℓp norm NP-hard, and for which is it Π2 -hard? In particular, we reiterate that the problem of showing NP-hardness of exact GapCRP in the ℓ2 norm (the most important special case) remains open. We again note that the AM protocol of [15] for approximate GapCRP (conditionally) rules out Π2 -hardness for γ-GapCRPp for γ ≥ 2, but says nothing about NP-hardness of γ-GapCRPp . Manurangsi [29] notes that no such analogous AM protocol is known for LinDisc, and asks if one exists.
